scope: Source-informed candidate priorities for the two active Wowhead SBA-compatible catalog targets only: Brewmaster 268 Master of Harmony and Shadow 258 Voidweaver.
policy: Wowhead does not publish a full SBA-specific talent-point leveling order for either target. These are not measured best builds or a replacement for legal tree prerequisites. Apply an item only when its spellID is present in the selected full target; let normal prerequisite order decide everything else.
priorityMeaning: Higher integers are considered first after legal prerequisites. Every numeric acquisition score is an inference from source guidance, not an author-published leveling order. definitionID is the current selected talent definition; spellID is its current spell effect from the live talent data.

priorities.shortReason: Selected core loop talent that grants Shuffle and reduces Brew cooldowns.
priorities.rationale: Wowhead calls this a core rotational skill; its Brewmaster effect grants Shuffle and reduces Brew cooldowns, so it supports both the SBA damage loop and tank foundation.

priorities.shortReason: Selected core defensive talent that preserves Brewmaster's survival base.
priorities.rationale: Wowhead describes Purifying Brew as a core defensive skill and fundamental component; it preserves the tank survival base while following the selected build.

priorities.shortReason: Selected Blackout Kick upgrade scored from the guide's core-loop priority.
priorities.rationale: The selected target contains Improved Blackout Kick. The guide's Blackout Kick-on-cooldown guidance makes this a bounded acquisition inference for the selected target's core loop.

priorities.shortReason: Selected Master of Harmony trigger for stored-vitality throughput.
priorities.rationale: The selected Master of Harmony target chooses Celestial Infusion. Wowhead describes Celestial Brew/Celestial Infusion as the Aspect of Harmony trigger, so this is a selected-target synergy inference.

priorities.shortReason: Selected rotation passive that Wowhead says is important to use well.
priorities.rationale: The selected SBA-compatible build includes Blackout Combo, and Wowhead's rotation guide calls it important to use effectively. Its acquisition position is inferred, not source-prescribed.

priorities.shortReason: Selected burst/threat cooldown with a short melee-damage reduction.
priorities.rationale: Wowhead recommends it once unlocked for burst, threat and a brief enemy melee reduction; it is kept below the rotational and survival foundation as an optional selected-target cooldown.

priorities.shortReason: Selected Insanity spender; score inferred from Wowhead's rotation.
priorities.rationale: Wowhead's rotation spends Insanity on this spell (historically named Devouring Plague); placing its selected talent definition early is an acquisition inference.

priorities.shortReason: Selected passive that spreads direct damage to Vampiric Touch targets.
priorities.rationale: Wowhead describes Psychic Link as a passive that spreads direct damage to Vampiric Touch targets, so its selected talent definition is a bounded passive-SBA-synergy inference.

priorities.shortReason: Selected Voidweaver payoff for the guide's Void Torrent interaction.
priorities.rationale: Wowhead says Voidweaver uses Void Torrent to transform Mind Blast into Void Blast. The selected Void Blast definition is therefore a target-specific acquisition inference.

priorities.shortReason: Selected proc talent named in Wowhead's Shadow priority list.
priorities.rationale: Wowhead explicitly calls out Shadowy Insight procs in the rotation. Turning that importance into a selected-talent acquisition score remains an inference.

priorities.shortReason: Selected DoT synergy inferred from Wowhead's maintain-your-DoTs guidance.
priorities.rationale: Wowhead emphasizes maintaining Shadow's DoTs. The selected Misery definition is a bounded quality-of-life acquisition inference, not a published leveling recommendation.
